message.content: {"caption":"Two-iteration workflow showing an agent’s initial incorrect answer, a proposed data-extraction skill, and a correct answer after the skill is loaded.","description":"A two-stage process diagram. In both stages, a dark circular robot icon labeled “Base Agent” connects by a gray right-pointing arrow to an orange lightbulb icon labeled “Proposer,” which connects by another gray right-pointing arrow to a green tool icon labeled “Skill Builder.” The arrows have no labels. Iteration 0: a question card asks for the continuously compounded average annual growth rate in Seigniorage, in millions of nominal dollars. The adjacent skills panel says “skills/” and “(empty).” The red-accented Agent Output card shows “final_answer = 7.8%,” a red X with “0.0,” and “Ground truth: -6.3%,” indicating an incorrect answer. The orange-accented Proposed Skill card says to create “data-extraction-verification,” a rigorous protocol for extracting numerical data from Treasury Bulletin tables. The message trace says the agent found the 1955 value and verified the table entries, names “Table 5 – Seigniorage on Silver (cumulative from Jan 1, 1935),” gives the formula r = ln(V₁₉₅₅ / V₁₉₄₅) / 10, and ends with final_answer = 7.8%. A dashed vertical downward arrow leads to Iteration 1. Its question card asks for the arithmetic mean of Total Liabilities. The skills panel shows a tree under “skills/”: “data-extraction-verification/,” containing “SKILL.MD” and a “scripts/” folder with “data_extraction.py.” A small legend says “skills available to agent,” and a “skills loaded” tag appears by the Base Agent. The green-accented Agent Output card contains a wrench-marked “data-extraction-verification” skill tag, “final_answer = 990822.83,” a green check with “1.0,” and “Ground truth: 990822.83,” indicating a correct answer matching the ground truth. The final message trace says it found the relevant table, “SECTION I – Liabilities to Foreigners,” shows a Skill tool call using “data-extraction-verification,” and ends with final_answer = 990822.83. The comparison is therefore a first-iteration answer marked wrong, followed by a second-iteration answer marked correct after the skill becomes available.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
